verdict.rationale: Better Stack's AI SRE produces in-product insights and suggestions from user data. It investigates incidents using logs, metrics, traces, errors and web events, and answers natural-language requests for logs or charts. It also suggests fixes as GitHub PRs, proposes AI-based Linear tickets during downtime, and generates automated post-mortems. Much of this lives in Slack or Teams, with an online chat as the in-product surface. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the in-app AI insight surface beyond marketing pages, independent or hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality, and detail on proactive (unprompted) insights.
